title: Annotation workbench
description: Machine-generated Trace V5 analysis: campaign coverage, findings, milestones, rubric judgments, and audit. A projection bound to immutable trace, evidence-head, and optional verifier-result digests — never annotation authority, never human visual_annotations.

inputs.name: evidence
inputs.description: Bounded annotation workbench projection (campaign, jobs, findings, milestones, audit). Content-addressed evidence-head digest when kind is annotation_evidence_head.

inputs.name: trace
inputs.description: Sealed Trace V5 identity the findings cite. Optional: the evidence projection already carries a compact span index for drill-down.

inputs.name: rubric
inputs.description: VerifierResultV2 digest. Absent or empty evidence renders Unavailable, never a zero score.
